title: RDE Assessment Storage Record (informative draft v0.1)
description: Informative draft JSON Schema for a logical rde_assessments row shape (payload + M2 metadata). NOT normative; does not replace SLS-4/SLS-9. See docs/rde-assessment-storage-increment.md and kotonoha-spec #47.

payload.description: Evaluation JSONB; MAY contain rde_review_output per SLS-4.

payload_schema_version.description: Interchange spec_version when payload embeds Phase 1 RDE output.

validation_report.description: Machine-readable validation summary at attach time.

rde_document_id.description: Optional FK when interchange row materialized in rde_documents.
